title: VPG Engine — Moves
description: Schema for the move catalog. A move's slot_ids list the slots it is eligible for; its groups record which slot groups those came from.

schema_version.description: Increment when the schema shape changes in a breaking way. 2 added slot_ids and animation_id.

field_definitions.description: Human-readable documentation of each field. Not validated structurally.

snake_case_id.description: snake_case identifier: lowercase letters, digits, and underscores; must start with a letter.

move_id.description: Move identifier. Looser than other ids — allows leading digits (e.g. '450_splash', '10_punch') because real wrestling moves use them. Must be lowercase, digits, and underscores only.

position.description: Must mirror the position enum in move-slots.schema.json.

power.description: Power grade S (highest) through G (lowest), or null for moves that do no damage (taunts, evasion).

feature.description: 'pin' for moves ending in a pin attempt, 'submit' for submission attempts, null for neither.

groups.description: Slot groups from move-slots.json that this move was drawn from. Descriptive only — eligibility is decided by slot_ids, which may be a strict subset of the slots these groups cover. Cross-file integrity is validated separately.

slot_ids.description: Authoritative list of slot ids from move-slots.json this move can fill. Cross-file integrity is validated separately.

animation_id.description: Animation clip id, or null while the move is unanimated.
